To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the fine classification based on morphology, optical spectral features and colour provides a powerful way to understand the nature of galaxies, because the fine classification is based on the combination of various physical parameters, which can be investigated in a more quantitative manner than the classification based on morphology alone.

(i) the nature of the SDSS galaxies in various fine classes based on morphology colour and spectral features can be investigated from radio to far infrared; (ii) the properties of each fine class can be understood by considering the properties of the galaxies in the class and the properties of other fine classes that have similar properties; and (iii) the properties of the fine classes can be understood by comparing the properties of the classes with the properties of galaxies in the class.
the nature of the galaxies in various classes of the SDSS galaxies based on morphology colour and spectral features is investigated from radio to the X ray using various multi wavelength data sets.

the nature of the fine classes is determined by their optical properties, and the multi wavelength properties of galaxies in the same fine class are similar to each other, but they are different from those in other fine classes, which is a natural result of the classification method.
the nature of each fine class of galaxies is not simple but complex, which is consistent with the hierarchical structure formation scenario.
